question: Which of the following is NOT a member of the Arthropoda phylum?
solution:
The Correct Answer is **Plia.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct answer is **option 4 (Pila)**, which is not a member of the Arthropoda phylum.
 
• **Arthropoda** is the largest phylum in the animal kingdom which includes creatures like locusts, butterflies, and prawns.
 
• **Pila** belongs to the phylum **Mollusca**, not Arthropoda. It is a genus of air-breathing freshwater snails.
 
• Members of the Arthropoda phylum are characterized by their jointed limbs and chitinous exoskeleton which is periodically shed or molted.
 
• Arthropods play crucial roles in ecosystems and human economy, serving as pollinators, decomposers, and a source of food.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Characteristic
 Description
 
 
 
 

 Diversity
 Arthropoda is the most diverse phylum in the animal kingdom, with over a million described species.
 
 

 Subphyla
 Includes Crustacea (crabs, lobsters, prawns), Hexapoda (insects), Myriapoda (centipedes, millipedes), and Chelicerata (spiders, scorpions).
 
 

 Habitats
 Arthropods can be found in virtually every habitat on Earth, from deep sea to high mountains.
 
 

 Exoskeleton
 The exoskeleton is made of chitin and provides protection, support, and assists in locomotion.
 
 

 Economic Importance
 Arthropods are vital for pollination, as food sources, and in controlling pest populations.
